:::{#exm-substitution-logic}
#### Simplifying part of a proposition
<!-- no-figure: a one-line rewriting; nothing to plot -->

By [double negation](#thm-double-negation),
$\neg \neg Q \equiv Q$.
Take $F$ to be $\neg P \lor \neg \neg Q$,
with $A = \neg \neg Q$ and $B = Q$.
By [replacing a part by an equivalent part](#thm-substitution-logic),

$$
\neg P \lor \neg \neg Q \equiv \neg P \lor Q.
$$

:::
